Built Azure Retail Prices REST API ingestion that normalized regional Spot and on-demand records, isolated Linux and Windows meters, rejected invalid prices, and recovered throttled pages through bounded retries.

Extended SQLModel/PostgreSQL writers with Alembic migrations, preserving Azure prices before full catalog metadata was available and reconciling placeholders after enrichment without changing AWS/GCP writer behavior.
Added pytest fixtures and GitHub Actions checks for Python, Ruff, and TypeScript.
Built the GitOps delivery path for an existing Java/Spring Boot pricing service: Docker and Maven tests, ECR images, cross-repository Helm updates, Argo CD, and validated EKS deployment.
Deployed five Dockerized API, UI, and scraper services on GKE with Terraform, Kustomize, TimescaleDB persistence, Workload Identity, multi-cloud credentials, and scheduled workloads.
Built a FastAPI/React Microsoft Entra validation workflow that collects Graph data, runs OPA/Rego checks, and presents persisted, explainable policy results with NIST 800-171 control views.

Designed a YAML manifest-driven workflow engine that models tenant-data collection as a DAG of source, transform, and final-object steps, making the pattern reusable for future Microsoft 365 product pipelines.
Built reusable Graph clients and fan-out collection handlers with structured error handling for expired tokens, external-call failures, invalid responses, and missing persisted results.
Developed React/Vite views for progress polling, persisted results, and policy-level explanations.
Implemented server-side OAuth/OIDC with MSAL, tenant allowlisting, cached token acquisition, and token-expiry checks.
Led an asynchronous Python/RabbitMQ/S3 document-processing pipeline that decoupled OCR and LLM extraction, generated validated outputs, and stored results in SQLite for a web application.
Reduced ingestion failures by 23% with AJV validation and strict JSON Schema contracts for extracted output.
Initialized a modular React codebase with Tailwind and MUI for the document-processing web app.
Cut FedEx issue-resolution time 38% with 10+ HTML5/CSS3 cargo-tracking components.
Built FedEx's shipping-document workflow with browser PDF previews and automated email delivery; improved release quality through Agile/Scrum, debugging, CI checks, and automated tests.
Improved Farmers Insurance CRM data integration, reducing redundancy by 21% across more than 1M customer records.
Expanded Farmers Insurance alert workflows for 30K+ users with counters, contextual alerts, and search.
Reduced licensing-board update time from 15 minutes to 5 seconds by automating PDF discovery, applicant extraction, JSON updates, validation, and pull-request creation with GitHub Actions.

Built a React/TypeScript and Flask web app with PostgreSQL/SQLAlchemy persistence for editable image annotations and exports; integrated automatic detections with user correction and deployed the web application with Docker, Nginx, Gunicorn, database migrations, and GitHub Actions.
